journey.name: Workout history
journey.description: End a workout after its first round, find it in History, then clear History. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: Verify that a dialog titled "End workout?" says "1 of 8 rounds done"
Verify that the summary shows "Ended" and "Saved to history"
Verify that a "Today" section lists one workout and "Last 7 days" shows 1 workout
Verify that a dialog titled "Clear history?" is shown
Verify that the screen shows "Finished workouts show up here."
